objective: Make application startup transactional so a failed component startup stops every component that already reached RUNNING, records an explicit failed state and operator diagnostics, and remains idempotent across repeated startup and shutdown calls.
acceptance: startup records the ordered components that reached RUNNING in started_components
a component whose startup returns False or raises marks the manager state failed and prevents the manager from claiming running
every component that reached RUNNING is stopped in reverse order before the failure is returned
the component whose startup failed is also released, because it may have acquired resources before reporting failure
a component whose shutdown hook raises is marked ERROR and its name and error are preserved in rollback_failures for operator diagnosis
a shutdown that cannot release a component does not set the manager state to stopped
a component still in CREATED is never sent a shutdown it never paired with a startup
repeated startup of a running system and repeated shutdown of a stopped system are idempotent
a failed startup can be retried once the cause is corrected
evidence: focused lifecycle test output for first-component failure, mid-sequence rollback, a raising component, rollback failure, retry, repeated startup, repeated shutdown and shutdown failure
demonstration that the focused tests fail against the previous implementation and pass against the fix
full repository test and Task Packet gate output
stop_conditions: the fix requires changing the registration or lookup API used by existing callers
a supervision, restart-backoff or health-check policy is required, which is a separate design decision
an interfaces schema or libs/contracts change is required
a modification outside allowed_paths is required
